jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Insights
jobs.description:
Onwards Together!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

Our Team's Vision

Our Engineering team is shaping the future of cybersecurity. We thrive on visionary leadership, autonomy, and ownership, fostering a culture of innovation that propels us forward in the ever-evolving cybersecurity landscape.

As a leader in Zero Trust Segmentation, we are redefining security for a world facing unprecedented cyber threats. You’ll work with a highly scalable SaaS service built using cloud-native technologies and increasingly powered by agentic AI systems and large language models (LLMs) to deliver intelligent, adaptive, and resilient applications at hyperscale.

We are making significant investments in AI-native product capabilities, where autonomous agents, contextual reasoning, real-time decisioning, and LLMs augment human workflows and unlock new levels of insight, automation, and customer value.

Our guiding philosophy in Engineering is to get things right by practicing disciplined engineering — focusing on quality, avoiding shortcuts, and having fun while doing it. We believe in enabling ownership at all levels of the organization and empowering teams. If you thrive in this culture, come join us!

Your Impact

This role combines hands-on technical contributions with managerial responsibilities. You will be at the center of important product and technology initiatives, with significant visibility, responsibility, and growth potential.
You will lead the team responsible for the newly launched SaaS Insights product, define and execute its roadmap, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product growth.
You will drive the strategy, design, and delivery of AI-powered product capabilities, leveraging agentic workflows and large language models (LLMs) to create differentiated, intelligent user experiences and automation at scale.
You will champion the adoption of Agentic AI and LLMs across engineering to increase productivity, accelerate innovation, and enable teams to move faster through AI-assisted development, code generation, testing, and operations.
You will partner with leaders across engineering, operations, product management, and other functions to make critical decisions on roadmap direction, customer feedback, and integration with the broader Illumio platform.
You will ensure the correctness, scalability, and modularity of the architecture and implementation, while maintaining compliance with regulatory standards and security best practices.
You will grow and develop a top-tier engineering team, working closely with senior technical leads and cross-functional leaders.
You will define, manage, and enforce milestone gates to ensure feature completeness and quality, while balancing business priorities with deadlines and delivering on time to the largest and most demanding enterprise customers.
As part of the technical leadership community at Illumio, you will play a critical role in product planning, working closely with senior executives to set business milestones, define resource requirements, and influence our long-term technical and business strategy.

Your Toolkit

Experience managing 10+ full-time engineers in a global environment, with 10+ years in roles of increasing responsibility and technical leadership.
Significant experience building and delivering scalable, cloud-native enterprise SaaS products and services. Proven track record of taking enterprise software products from inception through to successful customer delivery.
Strong, hands-on experience with AI/ML system design and production deployment, including prompt engineering, data pipelines, observability, evaluation frameworks, and cost/performance/latency trade-offs in production LLM-powered applications.
Proven experience designing, building, and shipping AI-assisted products, with practical, real-world experience using large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows to deliver customer-facing automation and innovation.
Experience with modern public cloud infrastructure (particularly AWS and Azure), containerization and orchestration technologies, and DevOps tools and best practices.
Experience developing and supporting enterprise software in regulated environments (e.g., FedRAMP, PCI) is highly desired.
Outstanding interpersonal skills, intellectual curiosity, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a passion for driving a culture of innovation and continuous improvement leveraging AI, strong leadership behaviors, and decisive actions.
BS in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

Our Commitment

Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.

All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.

jobs.title: Director, Applied AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Role Overview:
As a Director, Applied AI Engineering , you will shape and own the engineering strategy and technical direction for your service line-translating business objectives into engineering strategy, mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape, and defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver. You will develop and execute a forward-looking technology roadmap that drives simplification, scalability, and efficiency-rationalizing the landscape and integrating the service line's portfolio within the wider enterprise across multiple upstream and downstream systems. Leading across product groups and the service line, you will stay hands-on in your craft-shaping architecture, integration, design, and code-while driving the standards and enterprise reference architectures that engineers build against.

Your leadership will be pivotal in delivering tangible value across the service line's product and AI investments, aligning technical solutions with business and technology strategy, and advancing Applied AI engineering across the organization. You will bring extensive engineering craftsmanship and deep expertise across software and data engineering, enterprise and integration architecture, and AI/ML and GenAI, together with an exemplary track record of high-quality, outcome-focused delivery at scale. The ideal candidate is a role-model engineering leader who leads by doing -owning strategy, elevating standards, developing engineers and emerging leaders, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders from engineering teams to senior executives and service-line leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Vision and Alignment: Accountable for defining, communicating, and continuously refining the engineering strategy for the service line-translating business objectives into actionable strategy, mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape, defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver, and shaping how those products integrate within the enterprise across multiple upstream and downstream systems-in alignment with the Business Strategy and US Deloitte Technology strategy. Collaborate with diverse stakeholders and executives, including businesses and enabling areas as well as product, engineering, experience, delivery, security, and infrastructure teams, across all organizational levels.
Advocacy and Technology Roadmap: Champion, own, and execute the integrated Applied AI engineering, architecture, and technology strategy and its implementation roadmap across the service line-driving simplification, scalability, and efficiency, and actively rationalizing the landscape by removing unnecessary systems, integrations, and bottlenecks. Ensure the organization is well-informed about objectives, KPIs, maturity, compliance, and progress. Promote a culture of reuse, quality, and speed-keeping an eye on leverage of existing assets and on the inference, token, and cloud cost of what we build, to maximize outcomes and minimize total cost.
Craft Mastery and Objectives Realization: Define, measure, and drive the achievement of KPIs and NFRs spanning system performance, scalability, security, reliability, interoperability, auditability, and maintainability, and own engineering health and delivery KPIs across the product groups and the service line. Establish and evolve Applied AI engineering, enterprise and integration architecture, and AI/ML/GenAI reference architectures, standards, and best practices-including spec- and context-driven development, evaluations, AI agent orchestration, and the AI and Agentic SSDLC that carries work from discovery to production to operations with full automation and quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Remain hands-on with design, architecture, integration, and code-contributing to product group and service line velocity and staying engaged with engineers across the SSDLC-while reviewing standards and code, driving tech-debt reduction, and experimenting with new technology.
Capability Evolution and Development: As a recognized engineering leader, mentor and develop engineers and emerging leaders, building the engineering talent bench across the product groups and the service line. Coach modern Applied AI engineering practices-full-stack and micro-services, integration tools and practices, cloud-native design, AI/ML/GenAI and agentic systems, data engineering, application-level infrastructure-as-code, and advanced deployment techniques (Blue-Green, Canary, A/B testing) that minimize downtime. Lead by example through thought leadership-showcasing experiments internally, speaking at conferences, publishing whitepapers or blogs, and leading R&D collaborations, including with academia and communities. Cultivate a growth mindset and modern engineering behaviors across the organization.
Iterative Value Delivery: Embrace an iterative and incremental approach to Applied AI product engineering and integration architecture, favoring action and rapid learning over extensive upfront planning. Apply a leaning-forward approach and empirical methods to navigate complexity and uncertainty, ensuring each iteration delivers value and stays aligned with customer and business goals.
Customer-Centric Problem Solving: Maintain a relentless focus on solving the most critical challenges faced by customers and users, aligning technical solutions with business outcomes. Minimize unnecessary technical complexity and avoid overengineering-features, functionality, and integration approaches that do not add value-and drive teams toward peak performance through continuous learning and collaborative execution. Collaborate, challenge, and own technical decisions advocated by business or other groups that do not fit or advance the enterprise ecosystem.
Expert Proficiency and Continuous Improvement: Possess deep expertise in modern Applied AI engineering and architecture practices, with a keen ability to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for innovation across the technology landscape and the product lifecycle. Continuously enhance the engineering operating model to be lean, adaptable, and responsive-guiding and transforming the organization to embrace lean principles and foster a culture of innovation.
Tech/Quality Risk Management: Establish and evolve enterprise reference architectures, coding standards, and engineering and quality benchmarks that ensure robust, secure, scalable, and reliable/resilient solutions. Ensure appropriate, responsible technology adoption-developing explainable, scalable, reliable, and secure AI and agentic products-and proactively identify technical risks, developing mitigation strategies through proactive problem-solving and contingency planning, ensuring operational excellence and resilience across the product groups and the service line.
Influential Communication: Influence, persuade, and drive decision-making across the organization. Communicate effectively in both written and verbal forms, crafting clear, structured arguments and technical trade-offs supported by evidence.
Organizational Engagement and Collaboration: Engage stakeholders at all levels-from team members and middle management to senior executives and service-line leadership-building collaborative, constructive relationships and co-creating momentum and value across the organization.

The team:
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The successful candidate will possess:

Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

Required Qualifications:

A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
12+ years of full-stack software engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, .NET, Java, SQL/NoSQL, REST/SOAP/GraphQL, SSO/MFA, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit and integration testing frameworks.
8+ years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise solutions on modern technology stacks (e.g., API Gateways, Message Brokers, Queuing Services, Workflow Automation & Orchestration, ETL/ELT, Event Streaming, Real-Time Data Processing, Service Mesh) and cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, and micro-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including leveraging their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI, plus application-level infrastructure-as-code and cost-aware engineering (FinOps accountability).
5+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration.
5+ years of experience in establishing enterprise engineering standards, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding large engineering teams in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards.
Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high-quality products rapidly.
Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select locations available for this role
Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week

Other:

Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

jobs.title: Director, eCommerce Engineering
jobs.description:
World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe.

Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world-class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution capabilities.

With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada.

Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!

What is the Internal WWT IT Team, and why join?

The Internal WWT IT team is the backbone of our company’s technological infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations and continuous innovation. Our team is dedicated to managing and supporting the company’s technology infrastructure, ensuring the smooth operation of hardware, software, networks, and data systems, while providing top-notch technical support to employees.

By joining the Internal WWT IT team, you will play a crucial role in maintaining the efficiency and security of our IT environment, enabling the company to achieve its strategic goals. The Internal IT team offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, where your contributions will have a direct impact on the company's success. If you are passionate about technology and eager to take on new challenges, we encourage you to apply and join our team.

About The Role

You'll own our unified eCommerce platform — the digital connection between our customers and everything they buy from us, delivering one consistent experience across multiple brands.

The new platform is in the early phases of rollout. The foundation is in place and the first capabilities are shipping, which means the architecture, the standards, and the roadmap ahead are still open. You'd be joining early enough to shape what this platform becomes rather than inheriting someone else's finished system — and early enough that the decisions you make in your first year will still be visible in it years from now.

You'll lead roughly 30 employees through their leads: three functional delivery teams covering quoting and ordering, catalog and inventory, and fulfillment; two parallel run teams keeping the existing WWT and Softchoice storefronts healthy through the migration; and shared architecture, business analysis, QA, and UX groups spanning all of them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role, but you won't disappear into people, priorities, and trade-offs alone. You'll stay close enough to the technology to earn your teams' trust and to know when a plan won't survive contact with reality — sitting in design reviews, weighing in on architecture debates, reading pull requests, and picking up a story when it makes sense. We are not looking for someone who manages by dashboard.

Technical depth alone won't be enough. You'll need to become a functional expert in our commerce capabilities — how quoting, ordering, catalog, and fulfillment actually work for the customers and sellers who use them every day — and to bring that judgment into the room when we decide what to build and how it should behave.

What You'll Own

Our unified eCommerce platform — the foundation of this role. One platform delivering a consistent customer experience across multiple brands, digitally connecting our customers to the products and services they purchase from us. It is early in its rollout, so its architecture and direction are still yours to shape. Today that also means the WWT and Softchoice storefronts and customer enablement, run in parallel while the new platform comes online.
Order Status — including AI-powered agents that surface order details, and shaping where we take AI in the product: how internal and external users interact with order data, and what we're willing to automate.
Customer Projects — a single digital experience representing every phase of a customer engagement, bringing quoting, inventory, services, and the KPIs customers need to succeed into one view, with self-service security and access controls inside their account.

Build and unify the organization

Finish unifying the eCommerce engineering organization across WWT and Softchoice — one cohesive team culture, shared engineering standards, and consistent delivery practices across every team.
Design and implement a staffing plan that builds healthy, high-performing teams capable of delivering across all platform areas.
Hold your leaders accountable for execution and results, and ensure that each team has what it needs to hit their goals.

Stay hands-on and set the technical direction

Participate in design as a contributor, not only a reviewer — working through architecture decisions with the team.
Pick up a story often enough to know how the codebase and deploy path actually feel.
Provide technical leadership and direction, working directly with the teams.
Bring AI-native engineering practices into the day-to-day work of your teams — how they design, build, review, and ship.
Raise the engineering bar: testing discipline, code quality, observability, and recovery speed.

Know the product as well as the platform

Become a functional expert in our commerce capabilities — quoting, ordering and checkout, punchout, catalog and pricing, configurators, fulfillment — fluent enough to discuss them with sellers, customers, and business stakeholders without a translator.
Partner with Product and UX to make the customer experience an ideal one, not merely a working one. Weigh in on flows, friction, and trade-offs early, while designs are still cheap to change.
Bring the customer's and the seller's point of view into engineering decisions — you should be able to say what a change will actually feel like for the person on the other end of it.
Use usage data, support escalations, and direct customer feedback to shape what your teams take on next.

Deliver results

Own the outcomes and the operation of the platform in every way. Delivery, quality, reliability, cost, and customer experience all land with you.
Deliver Customer Projects — quoting, inventory, services, and KPI views, plus the self-service access and security controls — to a high bar.
Define the KPIs and SLAs across the platform, Order Status, and Customer Projects, and use the data to measure adoption, performance, and customer impact.

Communicate and partner

Serve as the primary voice for eCommerce engineering strategy with senior leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners — including progress, risks, and the trade-offs behind your decisions.
Translate the needs of internal operations teams and external customers into clear priorities your teams can act on.
Partner across IT, the business, and Softchoice to make the eCommerce integration succeed on both sides.
Work closely with Product Managers to shape and pressure-test the roadmap — influencing priorities while respecting product ownership.

,

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) in Computer Science or Information Technology. A combination of education, training, and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
10+ years in software engineering, including enterprise commerce or other high-volume transactional platforms
5+ years leading engineering teams, including leading through other leaders
Current technical depth — you can read a pull request, hold your own in a design review, and write working code when it's needed
Modern eCommerce architecture and integration experience, and the cloud fluency to go with it
Experience scaling web applications for global reach and high availability — CDN and edge caching, multi-region deployment, redundancy and failover, peak capacity planning
A track record of owning platform KPIs and SLAs, and of partnering with Product and UX to shape both the roadmap and the experience it delivers — not only executing someone else's

Assist with the interviewing and selection of Area Chief Engineers and Property Level Chief Engineers and maintenance supervisors ensuring they meet the requirements with established brand or hotel standards and consistent with PHM core values

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com

Job Description

About Orthopaedics

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

We are searching for the best talent for Director R&D Software Navigation to be based out of Boston, MA

Purpose

The Director R&D Software Navigation will lead a growing software team responsible for delivering next generation surgical navigation systems. This role is a critical technical and people leadership position within Navigation Systems R&D for 5 platforms, combining deep expertise with strategic ownership of software architecture, execution, and quality.

This role is accountable for leading a team of Software Engineers and is responsible for defining, building, and sustaining robust, scalable, and safety critical software platforms that meet clinical, user, and regulatory requirements. Working closely with systems, hardware, clinical, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory partners, this role ensures that software solutions are architected and executed to meet system level performance, safety, and reliability objectives.

This position requires a functional & technical leader who can operate effectively in a highly regulated, multidisciplinary surgical environment, while mentoring teams, driving innovation, and enabling predictable, high quality delivery.

Job Responsibilities

Lead the full lifecycle development of software subsystems for surgical navigation platforms, from early concept and prototyping through verification, release, and post market support.
Collaborate with senior engineers and architects to define, own, and evolve the software platform and architecture, ensuring scalability, real time performance, safety, cybersecurity, and long term maintainability.
Establish technical direction and software roadmaps aligned with product strategy and system evolution.
Ensure software designs are compliant with system requirements, user needs, intended use, hazard mitigations, and regulatory expectations.
Partner with systems engineering, hardware, clinical, usability/human factors, quality, and manufacturing teams to translate user needs into clear, testable, traceable software requirements.
Lead and participate in architecture reviews, design reviews, and cross disciplinary technical trade off discussions.
Collaborate on the design and implementation of safe, intuitive user interfaces with human factors and clinical teams.
Support regulatory submissions, audits, inspections, and DHF completeness in partnership with quality and regulatory affairs.
Support controlled release pipelines aligned with design controls and change management
Lead adoption of automated unit-testing, integration, and system level testing to improve quality and delivery predictability.
Champion metrics driven development (build health, test coverage, defect trends) to drive continuous improvement.

Lead a high-visibility function at the center of how the enterprise builds software - and how AI reshapes that process.

jobs.description:

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The next era of enterprise technology will not be won by simply knowing the platform. It will be won by helping customers make the right architectural choices as AI reshapes how data, applications, experiences, security, and work come together.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Architecture & Innovation
to lead a multi-layered organization of Core Technical and Enterprise Architecture leaders and highly experienced talent across CBS.

This is not a traditional architecture leadership role.

We need a leader who can see around corners, create a point of view, mobilize teams quickly, and translate emerging technology into clear choices for customers and our field, someone who can move comfortably between an executive customer conversation, a deep architectural debate, a strategy session with Sales and Solutions leadership, and an executive update on what we are learning across the business.

You will lead teams responsible for helping customers understand how to govern AI responsibly, activate the full Salesforce platform, prepare data and architecture for production, and reimagine experiences as new technologies emerge.

Just as importantly, you will create leverage. The best work of the organization should not remain inside a single account or team. You will turn what we learn into strong points of view, architectural patterns, field guidance, and repeatable approaches that make the entire CBS organization better.

What You'll Do

Lead and Scale an Exceptional Architecture Organization

Lead and develop a multi-layered organization of frontline leaders and senior architects across a diverse set of architecture and innovation disciplines
Create a high bar for technical excellence, customer impact, pace, accountability, and executive presence
Build an environment where teams are encouraged to challenge assumptions, experiment thoughtfully, and bring forward new ideas before they are asked
Develop strong leaders who can independently run their businesses while operating as one integrated architecture organization
Attract, grow, and retain exceptional architecture talent while creating clear opportunities for career development and succession

Create the Architectural Point of View

Establish clear, proactive perspectives on the architectural questions our customers are facing across AI, data, security, governance, integration, platform strategy, emerging technology, and digital experiences
Anticipate where customer architecture is heading and ensure CBS is prepared to lead those conversations, not react to them
Move quickly from signal to insight to action, without waiting for perfect information when the field needs direction
Translate complex technical shifts into simple frameworks, reference architectures, patterns, and recommendations that customers and account teams can act on
Ensure the organization consistently connects architectural decisions to business outcomes, platform strategy, and the customer's path to production

Lead the Most Important Customer Conversations

Serve as a trusted architecture executive for strategic customers navigating complex transformation decisions
Lead conversations that help CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, and other technology leaders understand choices, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities
Elevate conversations beyond products and features to how the customer's technology landscape must evolve for an agentic enterprise
Create confidence when the answer is complex, multiple technologies are involved, or the path forward is not yet obvious
Step into critical opportunities and escalations with urgency, clarity, and strong executive judgment
Lead and participate in key customer on-sites, SICs, and workshops, as well as conferences (TDX, DF, etc.)

Make Customers Builder-Ready

Ensure architecture teams create the clarity required before hands-on building begins: business outcome, use case and scope, target architecture, data and grounding, actions and integrations, trust guardrails, dependencies, and path to production
Partner closely with Builder leadership so Builder teams enter engagements understanding the architecture, key decisions, dependencies, and definition of done
Maintain a clear distinction between architectural leadership and hands-on implementation while ensuring the two motions operate seamlessly together
Identify architectural blockers early and mobilize the right teams to resolve them before they slow execution
Help create repeatable patterns that move customers faster from strategy and experimentation to production

Be an Exceptional Cross-Functional Partner

Operate as a deeply trusted partner to Sales, Solutions, Builders, Success, Product, Engineering, and other specialist organizations
Bring teams together around the customer problem rather than organizational boundaries
Create clear roles and handoffs while maintaining shared accountability for the customer outcome
Partner with peers generously. The goal is not for Architecture to own every technical conversation, but to make every team around it stronger
Surface patterns from the field to Product and Engineering, and help translate product direction back into actionable guidance for customer-facing teams

Amplify the Work of the Team

Make exceptional work visible and reusable across CBS and Salesforce
Identify the ideas, architectures, customer lessons, and innovations that should be elevated beyond an individual engagement
Turn field learning into executive-ready narratives, POVs, reusable assets, and scalable enablement
Create mechanisms for architects to share ideas, challenge one another, and continuously raise the technical bar
Give individual architects and leaders visibility for their work, and create opportunities for the team's strongest voices to influence customers, the field, and our product strategy

Communicate With Clarity and Influence

Maintain strong communication with senior leadership on customer signals, architectural trends, emerging risks, team priorities, and opportunities
Distill a complex portfolio of work into the few things executives need to understand and act on
Bring recommendations, not just updates. Surface issues early, frame tradeoffs clearly, and propose a path forward
Build trust through transparency, strong judgment, and consistent follow-through
Represent the organization with credibility at every level, from deeply technical teams to Salesforce executives and customer C-suites

What Success Looks Like

You will know this organization is succeeding when:

Customers seek us out for the broader technical vision, not simply for answers to product questions
Our architects shape decisions earlier, before architecture becomes a blocker to execution
Builders start ready, with clearer architecture, dependencies, guardrails, and success criteria
Our best thinking scales, rather than remaining trapped inside individual accounts
Executive leadership has clear visibility into what the organization is learning, where customers are struggling, and where Salesforce should lean in
The team moves with urgency, taking initiative and creating direction rather than waiting for requests
Our leaders and architects are recognized voices with customers, internally, and in the broader technical community
Sales, Solutions, Builders, Success, and Product view Architecture as one of their strongest partners

What We're Looking For

Transformational Leadership

Proven experience leading leaders and senior technical talent through change. You create clarity, raise standards, build followership, and translate strategy into action.

Architecture & Technology Depth

Deep understanding of enterprise architecture and modern technology landscapes, including cloud platforms, data, AI, integration, identity, security, governance, APIs, and modern application and experience architectures. You do not need to be the deepest expert in every domain, but you must know how to lead experts and connect the pieces.

Executive Presence

Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical topics with senior customer and internal executives. You can simplify without losing substance and are comfortable challenging assumptions when needed.

Customer and Business Acumen

You understand that architecture exists to enable a business outcome. You can connect technical choices to value, risk, speed, adoption, and long-term platform strategy.

Strong Point of View

You are intellectually curious and proactive. You develop perspectives on where technology and customer needs are heading and are comfortable putting a recommendation on the table.

Bias for Action

You operate with urgency. You identify what needs to happen, mobilize the right people, and move. You are comfortable making progress in ambiguity and adjusting as new information emerges.

Organizational Influence

You are an exceptional collaborator who builds trust across organizational boundaries. You can align strong leaders with different priorities around a common outcome without relying on hierarchy.

Executive Communication

You know how to manage a complex portfolio upward. You surface what matters, make risks visible early, amplify the work of your team, and consistently bring senior leaders clarity and recommendations.

Talent Leadership

You are passionate about developing leaders and creating an environment where exceptional technical talent can do the best work of their careers.

THE LEADERSHIP PROFILE

We are looking for an operator, architect, storyteller, and multiplier: someone technical enough to earn the trust of our strongest architects, strategic enough to shape the direction of the business, customer-focused enough to command a C-suite conversation, and collaborative enough to make the organizations around them more successful.

Most importantly, we want a leader who does not wait for the future to arrive. They help define it.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The next era of enterprise technology will not be won by simply knowing the platform. It will be won by helping customers make the right architectural choices as AI reshapes how data, applications, experiences, security, and work come together.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Architecture & Innovation
to lead a multi-layered organization of Core Technical and Enterprise Architecture leaders and highly experienced talent across CBS.

This is not a traditional architecture leadership role.

We need a leader who can see around corners, create a point of view, mobilize teams quickly, and translate emerging technology into clear choices for customers and our field, someone who can move comfortably between an executive customer conversation, a deep architectural debate, a strategy session with Sales and Solutions leadership, and an executive update on what we are learning across the business.

You will lead teams responsible for helping customers understand how to govern AI responsibly, activate the full Salesforce platform, prepare data and architecture for production, and reimagine experiences as new technologies emerge.

Just as importantly, you will create leverage. The best work of the organization should not remain inside a single account or team. You will turn what we learn into strong points of view, architectural patterns, field guidance, and repeatable approaches that make the entire CBS organization better.

What You'll Do

Lead and Scale an Exceptional Architecture Organization

Lead and develop a multi-layered organization of frontline leaders and senior architects across a diverse set of architecture and innovation disciplines
Create a high bar for technical excellence, customer impact, pace, accountability, and executive presence
Build an environment where teams are encouraged to challenge assumptions, experiment thoughtfully, and bring forward new ideas before they are asked
Develop strong leaders who can independently run their businesses while operating as one integrated architecture organization
Attract, grow, and retain exceptional architecture talent while creating clear opportunities for career development and succession

Create the Architectural Point of View

Establish clear, proactive perspectives on the architectural questions our customers are facing across AI, data, security, governance, integration, platform strategy, emerging technology, and digital experiences
Anticipate where customer architecture is heading and ensure CBS is prepared to lead those conversations, not react to them
Move quickly from signal to insight to action, without waiting for perfect information when the field needs direction
Translate complex technical shifts into simple frameworks, reference architectures, patterns, and recommendations that customers and account teams can act on
Ensure the organization consistently connects architectural decisions to business outcomes, platform strategy, and the customer's path to production

Lead the Most Important Customer Conversations

Serve as a trusted architecture executive for strategic customers navigating complex transformation decisions
Lead conversations that help CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, and other technology leaders understand choices, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities
Elevate conversations beyond products and features to how the customer's technology landscape must evolve for an agentic enterprise
Create confidence when the answer is complex, multiple technologies are involved, or the path forward is not yet obvious
Step into critical opportunities and escalations with urgency, clarity, and strong executive judgment
Lead and participate in key customer on-sites, SICs, and workshops, as well as conferences (TDX, DF, etc.)

Make Customers Builder-Ready

Ensure architecture teams create the clarity required before hands-on building begins: business outcome, use case and scope, target architecture, data and grounding, actions and integrations, trust guardrails, dependencies, and path to production
Partner closely with Builder leadership so Builder teams enter engagements understanding the architecture, key decisions, dependencies, and definition of done
Maintain a clear distinction between architectural leadership and hands-on implementation while ensuring the two motions operate seamlessly together
Identify architectural blockers early and mobilize the right teams to resolve them before they slow execution
Help create repeatable patterns that move customers faster from strategy and experimentation to production

Be an Exceptional Cross-Functional Partner

Operate as a deeply trusted partner to Sales, Solutions, Builders, Success, Product, Engineering, and other specialist organizations
Bring teams together around the customer problem rather than organizational boundaries
Create clear roles and handoffs while maintaining shared accountability for the customer outcome
Partner with peers generously. The goal is not for Architecture to own every technical conversation, but to make every team around it stronger
Surface patterns from the field to Product and Engineering, and help translate product direction back into actionable guidance for customer-facing teams

Amplify the Work of the Team

Make exceptional work visible and reusable across CBS and Salesforce
Identify the ideas, architectures, customer lessons, and innovations that should be elevated beyond an individual engagement
Turn field learning into executive-ready narratives, POVs, reusable assets, and scalable enablement
Create mechanisms for architects to share ideas, challenge one another, and continuously raise the technical bar
Give individual architects and leaders visibility for their work, and create opportunities for the team's strongest voices to influence customers, the field, and our product strategy

Communicate With Clarity and Influence

Maintain strong communication with senior leadership on customer signals, architectural trends, emerging risks, team priorities, and opportunities
Distill a complex portfolio of work into the few things executives need to understand and act on
Bring recommendations, not just updates. Surface issues early, frame tradeoffs clearly, and propose a path forward
Build trust through transparency, strong judgment, and consistent follow-through
Represent the organization with credibility at every level, from deeply technical teams to Salesforce executives and customer C-suites

What Success Looks Like

You will know this organization is succeeding when:

Customers seek us out for the broader technical vision, not simply for answers to product questions
Our architects shape decisions earlier, before architecture becomes a blocker to execution
Builders start ready, with clearer architecture, dependencies, guardrails, and success criteria
Our best thinking scales, rather than remaining trapped inside individual accounts
Executive leadership has clear visibility into what the organization is learning, where customers are struggling, and where Salesforce should lean in
The team moves with urgency, taking initiative and creating direction rather than waiting for requests
Our leaders and architects are recognized voices with customers, internally, and in the broader technical community
Sales, Solutions, Builders, Success, and Product view Architecture as one of their strongest partners

What We're Looking For

Transformational Leadership

Proven experience leading leaders and senior technical talent through change. You create clarity, raise standards, build followership, and translate strategy into action.

Architecture & Technology Depth

Deep understanding of enterprise architecture and modern technology landscapes, including cloud platforms, data, AI, integration, identity, security, governance, APIs, and modern application and experience architectures. You do not need to be the deepest expert in every domain, but you must know how to lead experts and connect the pieces.

Executive Presence

Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical topics with senior customer and internal executives. You can simplify without losing substance and are comfortable challenging assumptions when needed.

Customer and Business Acumen

You understand that architecture exists to enable a business outcome. You can connect technical choices to value, risk, speed, adoption, and long-term platform strategy.

Strong Point of View

You are intellectually curious and proactive. You develop perspectives on where technology and customer needs are heading and are comfortable putting a recommendation on the table.

Bias for Action

You operate with urgency. You identify what needs to happen, mobilize the right people, and move. You are comfortable making progress in ambiguity and adjusting as new information emerges.

Organizational Influence

You are an exceptional collaborator who builds trust across organizational boundaries. You can align strong leaders with different priorities around a common outcome without relying on hierarchy.

Executive Communication

You know how to manage a complex portfolio upward. You surface what matters, make risks visible early, amplify the work of your team, and consistently bring senior leaders clarity and recommendations.

Talent Leadership

You are passionate about developing leaders and creating an environment where exceptional technical talent can do the best work of their careers.

THE LEADERSHIP PROFILE

We are looking for an operator, architect, storyteller, and multiplier: someone technical enough to earn the trust of our strongest architects, strategic enough to shape the direction of the business, customer-focused enough to command a C-suite conversation, and collaborative enough to make the organizations around them more successful.

Most importantly, we want a leader who does not wait for the future to arrive. They help define it.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Ministry Brands is looking for a  Senior Vice President, Software Engineering
to join our growing team!

Who We Are

Ministry Brands is a leading provider of SaaS operational management systems, payments platforms, digital engagement tools and background screening solutions for faith-based, non-profit and for-profit organizations. We serve more than 95,000 customers as a trusted partner in digital transformation and enablement – advancing missions, driving efficiencies, and building engaged communities for more than four decades. The diverse and real-world experiences of our team members serving their communities makes us stronger together and enhances our ability to advance digital transformation for the greater good.   

Available Location:
Milton, GA

Hybrid Working:
Team members are expected to come into the Alpharetta office as needed, based on business requirements and team collaboration needs. There is no fixed minimum number of in-office days; instead, attendance will be determined by project demands, meetings, and manager guidance. Any changes to your primary work location should follow the appropriate process as outlined in our handbook.

What You'll Do:

As the Senior Vice President, Software Engineering
, you will be a key member of Ministry Brands' technology leadership team, responsible for the strategy, execution, and organizational effectiveness of our software engineering organization. Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead multiple engineering teams and leaders responsible for building, enhancing, and operating products that serve thousands of churches and ministries.

You will help shape the future of our technology platforms, architecture, engineering practices, and development organization. You will balance technical excellence with business outcomes, ensuring our teams can innovate quickly while delivering secure, reliable, scalable, and high-quality software to our customers.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering Strategy & Leadership

Provide strategic direction and executive leadership for the software engineering organization, aligning engineering strategy with company objectives, product strategy, and customer needs.
Partner with the CTO and executive leadership to define and execute the company's technology strategy and long-term engineering roadmap.
Establish a global engineering operating model that enables high-performing teams to move quickly, collaborate effectively, and deliver predictable results.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

Execution & Delivery

Oversee the successful delivery of software initiatives from conception through deployment, ensuring appropriate quality, scope, budget, and timeline management.
Evolve the SDLC for AI-led development, enabling teams to increase speed and productivity while maintaining code quality, security, and reliability.
Establish clear engineering goals, performance metrics, and operating rhythms that improve delivery predictability and organizational performance.
Partner closely with Product Management, Design, Customer Success, and other business leaders to establish priorities and deliver against product roadmaps.
Ensure engineering teams remain focused on the highest-value initiatives and effectively balance new development, maintenance, modernization, and technical debt.

Architecture & Technology

Provide leadership and oversight for software architecture and technical strategy across Ministry Brands' products and platforms.
Lead the development of a unified data model and data architecture that brings together disparate product and customer data, enabling AI-powered experiences, intelligent automation, and scalable analytics across the platform.
Champion architectural principles including modularity, reusability, scalability, interoperability, maintainability, and security.
Develop and execute strategies for modernizing legacy platforms and reducing technical debt while maintaining business continuity.
Identify opportunities to responsibly leverage AI and other emerging technologies to improve engineering productivity and product capabilities.

Engineering Excellence

Establish and continuously improve engineering standards, development methodologies, coding practices, testing strategies, and deployment processes.
Drive adoption of modern software development and DevOps practices that enable teams to deliver high-quality software safely and efficiently.
Establish appropriate measures for software quality, reliability, security, engineering productivity, and delivery performance.
Promote automation and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle.
Ensure engineering practices support highly available, secure, scalable, and maintainable products.

Talent & Organization

Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization through effective leadership, talent acquisition, retention, coaching, and succession planning.
Establish clear career paths and development opportunities for engineers, managers, and engineering leaders.
Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional engineering leaders and create a strong leadership pipeline for the organization.
Establish performance expectations and foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous learning.
Effectively lead and integrate global engineering teams and external development partners.

Financial & Operational Management

Manage engineering operations, including organizational planning, budgeting, resource allocation, forecasting, and reporting.
Optimize the mix of internal engineering resources, global teams, contractors, and technology partners to deliver the greatest business value.
Ensure engineering investments are aligned with company priorities and deliver measurable business and customer outcomes.
Establish effective governance and decision-making processes for major technical and engineering investments.

Customer & Market Focus

Ensure engineering decisions are grounded in customer needs, market dynamics, and the evolving needs of churches and ministries.
Partner with Product and other business leaders to translate customer and market insights into technology and product opportunities.
Help ensure Ministry Brands' technology remains modern, competitive, and capable of supporting the evolving needs of the faith market.

Who You Are:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
10+ years of experience in software engineering or a related technical field.
10+ years of experience leading software engineering organizations, including significant experience managing managers and senior engineering leaders.
Proven experience leading engineering organizations through periods of growth, transformation, modernization, or organizational change.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute technology and engineering strategies that support business objectives.
Passionate about developing people and building an inclusive, accountable, and high-performing engineering culture.
Passion for using technology to help churches and non-profits more effectively accomplish their mission.
Demonstrated expertise in AI, SaaS, subscription software, or multi-product technology organizations.
Experience in the church, nonprofit, or faith-based technology market is a plus.

Physical Considerations:

Ability to work in a general office environment
Ability to handle extended periods of computer-based work, including telephone
Ability to work flexible and long hours, as needed, including outside regular business hours and days

Travel Considerations:
